Can describe your future contribution as an engineer, technician, or researcher in your own words. Can develop a 4-year learning plan and a future career plan based on your understanding of the significance of study at the university. Can communicate these plans and future prospects successfully with others.

              Our college nurtures the understanding of chemical and biological phenomena, as well as the ability to develop analytical skills that lead to successful chemical and biotechnological engineers. The objective of this course is to provide an understanding of the importance of university study, encourage the development of an attitude conducive to learning and curiosity, and develop the ability to prepare a plan to realize your future career goals.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              1. System of bioscience and chemistry (understand the 4-year curriculum flow chart)
2. Applications of chemistry in various industrial fields
3. Introduction to research fields and methods of fostering scientific reasoning
4. Introduction to state-of-the-art research by professors of the department
5. General exercises (writing assignments will be added to the portfolio)
